name: Gaham
title: Son of Nahor and Reumah
summary: Gaham was a son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by his concubine Reumah. He is briefly mentioned in the genealogy in Genesis. As part of Nahor's descendants, he is part of the broader family history of the patriarchs.

keyEvents.title: Gaham mentioned in Nahor's genealogy
keyEvents.description: After Abraham learned about Nahor's descendants, Gaham is mentioned as one of the sons of Nahor by his concubine Reumah.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's family grows
keyEvents.description: The genealogy in Genesis 22:20-24 tells of Nahor's twelve sons, including Gaham, showing a parallel to Abraham's own blessing of many descendants.

keyEvents.title: Reuma as Nahor's concubine
keyEvents.description: Gaham is one of four sons born to Nahor's concubine Reuma, in addition to the eight sons Nahor had with his wife Milcah.

keyEvents.title: The context of the genealogy
keyEvents.description: News of Nahor's descendants was brought to Abraham after he passed God's test by offering Isaac, linking Gaham's mention to a turning point in the history of the patriarchs.
